In 2023, with conflict mostly at a stalemate, Russia took 2,233 km² of territory. In 2024 so far have taken 2,656 km².

Experts have argued a large portion is rural and not of huge strategic value. Russian forces have mostly encircled but not taken major cities, & few major rail or road arteries have been severed recently. Russian control of Ukraine territory has increased from 17.4% in Nov 2023 to 17.9% in Nov 2024.

Mapping the land reveals Russia has mainly seized agricultural land but failed to make significant gains across territory with major urban or infrastructure value. As well as areas fully under Russian control, maps show Russian advances, indicating areas Russian forces are present but not in control
